request.source: catalog book, hand-authored; no request exists
request.tone: adventurous and wondering; perseverance and legacy; scariness moderate, peril moderate, violence none

pitch.hero: Wren, a would-be apprentice mapmaker of the Chart House, set ashore alone on an unnamed island
pitch.want: to fill one blank sheet with a true chart of the island before the ship returns at dusk and so win the apprenticeship
pitch.obstacle: tides, mud, caves, cliffs and heights, a short day, and endless lovely distractions that eat the light
pitch.stake: the apprenticeship; and, once found, finishing the work of Alder, the mapmaker who came before and never returned
pitch.ending_kind: branch and bottleneck: a finished and named chart at the summit, a rescue called in by signal, or an honest partial map or lesson where the day ran out

wren.name: Wren
wren.role: protagonist; Chart House apprentice candidate (no pronoun is ever used)
wren.want: a true chart before dusk, and to honour Alder's unfinished work
wren.voice: close third past; practical, careful, easily moved by wonders; reads land and water like a surveyor

mate.name: the mate
mate.role: the ship's mate who sets the test and judges the chart
mate.want: a mapmaker who looks with their own eyes and finishes the work
mate.voice: plain, weathered, a few judging lines at the end ('A map you never finish is no map at all')

alder.name: Alder
alder.role: the lost mapmaker who came before; present only through marks, notes, tools and a journal
alder.want: for someone to finish the chart and give the island its name
alder.voice: small sure hand; warm, brief notes ('The way up is behind you, friend')

sailors.name: two sailors
sailors.role: the boat crew sent in after the signal

truth.answer: Alder, a mapmaker of an earlier day who lived at the survey tower, mapped half the island and left the chart at a stone-and-canvas camp under the summit cliff before a storm took the boat that never came back. Clues across the island (driftwood shorthand, scratched names, notes, cairns, a bottle) all point to that camp. Only from the summit can the island be seen whole and the chart finished. Long before any mapmaker, the island's first people mapped it in ochre handprints and stars.

wren_test.text: Wren must fill one blank sheet with a true chart of the island before the ship returns at dusk, or the apprenticeship goes to someone else.

wren_alone.text: Wren is alone on the island with a satchel, a flask and one blank sheet; the rowboat has gone.

unnamed_island.text: No map has ever named the island.

five_ways.text: Five ways lead inland: the mangrove coast, the cloud-forest ridge, the sink-hole caverns, the survey tower on the headland, and the tidal flats.

chart_house.text: Wren trains under the Chart House, whose rules and teaching Wren knows.

alder_named.text: A mapmaker named Alder came to the island before Wren and left marks, notes and tools for whoever followed.

camp_exists.text: There is a camp on the island's high ridge.

chart_at_camp.text: A chart Alder began is said to wait at a camp on the ridge.
chart_at_camp.implicit_plant: set by the driftwood, the field notes, the logbook, the draft, the bottle; not required downstream (camp_ascent5 names the camp from a board over its door)

alder_lost_in_storm.text: Alder never came back: a storm took the boat that was to return.

ship_can_be_signalled.text: From a high place Wren could signal the ship to send help.

first_people.text: People found and mapped this island long before any chart was made.

cove_seen.text: Wren has seen the hidden cove ringed by cliffs inside the reef.

turtle_stranded.text: A small sea turtle lies stranded on its back in a draining pool among the oyster rocks on the mangrove coast, near the reef channel that feeds them.
turtle_stranded.implicit_plant: never paid off directly; the summit turtle (reef_turtle_sighted) may be read as the same animal by a reader who marked it

pup_in_cave.text: A young seal pup is stranded on a ledge in the warm bat cave, having come in through a flooded sea tube.
pup_in_cave.implicit_plant: never paid off directly; the pup heard at meet_boat (pup_heard_in_sea_cave) may be read as the same animal by a reader who marked it

spring_water_above.text: Fresh water running down means a spring on higher ground above.

caverns_flood.text: The caverns flood fast and deep at high tide.

mangrove_maze.text: The mangrove coast is a maze of roots and mud where a wrong step can swallow a boot.

mg_bearings.text: From the mangroves: a log bridge upcoast, oyster rocks downcoast, a hidden creek inland, and a still green lagoon.

log_bridge.text: A slippery fallen log crosses a channel where the tide is turning, with a carved driftwood knot halfway and a heron rookery on the far bank.

driftwood_carving.text: The driftwood bears a mapmaker's shorthand: arrows back toward the sea caves and up toward high ground.

herons_burst.text: Hundreds of herons burst up from the far bank; the path splits between a mud slick and firm palms.

stuck_in_mud.text: Wren stuck in the mud slick; the tide closed over the log bridge and cut off that corner of coast.

goat_track.text: From the high ground a goat track runs down to the cove and inland toward a spring gully.

turtle_marked.text: Wren marked the turtle's spot to send help later.

turtle_righted.text: Wren righted the turtle and it swam away; only that corner got mapped.

seep_gully.text: The seep climbs into a fern gully that forks to the spring pool and a mossy overhang.

alder_scratched_name.text: Under the mossy overhang an old firepit, a tin cup, and the scratched name Alder with an arrow uphill to a camp.

shelter_sketched.text: Wren spent the morning sketching the dry shelter and left the island blank.

otters_creek.text: A mother otter and two kits slip up the hidden creek; firm trees rise to one side and a heron island lies across the water.

trail_loops.text: The level game trail curls back on itself with no landmark in sight.

walked_in_circle.text: The mangrove walked Wren in a circle for an hour; the middle of the coast stayed blank.

lagoon_three.text: At the lagoon: a half-sunk dugout canoe, a root tunnel, and a driftwood dam.

dugout.text: The dugout is old; it might float if tested carefully, or sink if trusted too far.

canoe_sank.text: The dugout sank in the lagoon and the morning went with it.

cleared_ground.text: Across the lagoon lies a strip of old cleared ground with a stone mound and weathered posts.

fishing_village.text: The stones and posts are the remains of a vanished fishing camp, older than any chart.

village_mapped.text: Wren mapped the vanished village in detail and little else.

root_tunnel_fork.text: The root tunnel forks toward open sky and deeper dark.

tunnel_lost.text: Wren got lost in the branching root passages and backtracked by feel.

alder_stake.text: A survey stake of Alder's stands in the otters' driftwood dam.

stake_taken.text: Wren prised Alder's stake free as a keepsake and barely mapped.

heron_island.text: Wren poled a reed raft to the heron island: a watching blind, a mud bank, and a rookery.

alder_tide_table.text: The watching blind is carved with Alder's tide table and named bearings of every headland.

tide_table_copied.text: Wren copied the whole tide table and left the island's shape for another day.

sand_ribbon.text: A firm ribbon of sand crosses the mud bank; off it the mud grips deep.

birdstorm.text: Wren cut across the mud bank, startled the flock and sank knee-deep.

lookout_rise.text: Beyond the far channel a low rise looks over the northern coast.

chick_saved.text: Wren put a fallen heron chick back on a branch and sketched the rookery.

rookery_drawn.text: Wren watched the rookery too long and drew birds instead of coast.

cf_ways.text: On the ridge: a steep switchback, a gentle traverse, a hollow with a pale gleam, and the roar of a waterfall.

switch_ledge.text: The switchback ledge splits to a bare rock rib and a green shelf.

contour_path.text: The green shelf is an old surveyor's contour path.

grassy_bench.text: The grassy bench on the ridge shoulder is where the stony trail toward the camp begins.

ancient_grove.text: A grove of giant mossy trees stands off the bench.

cairns_to_camp.text: A line of small cairns marks the safe way up the broken ground toward the camp.

ridge_split.text: The cairned ridge splits to a sheltered ledge and an airy crest.

froze_on_ridge.text: Wren froze on the airy ridge and mapped it from lower down.

alder_camp_found.text: Alder's camp of grey canvas and stone stands at the base of the summit cliff.

spring_found.text: Wren has found the island's spring, the cold pool where every stream begins.

orchid_tin_box.text: Behind a curtain of white orchids sits a moss-furred tin box marked with a compass rose.

locket_girl.text: The box holds field notes and a brass locket with a girl who looks a little like Wren.

locket_kept.text: Wren pocketed the locket and mapped the ridge in a distracted scrawl.

waterfall_ways.text: At the waterfall: wet rocks to climb, a mossy log above the lip, and pale shapes in the pool.

slipped_falls.text: Wren slipped from the wet rocks into the pool and the climbing was over.

water_gauge.text: A notched stone slab in the pool is Alder's water gauge.

gauge_copied.text: Wren copied the water gauge and left the coast blank.

frayed_ladder.text: A frayed rope ladder climbs into the grove canopy; a small cairn shrine stands among the roots.

ladder_failed.text: A rotten rung broke and Wren climbed down without the view.

alder_treetop.text: At the top is Alder's treetop survey point with a brass sighting ring.

canopy_lingered.text: Wren lingered in the canopy and drew one view.

grove_shrine.text: The shell-dressed shrine with a carved wooden bird was set by the island's first people.

shrine_lingered.text: Wren sat long by the shrine and drew only that.

hidden_dell.text: A deer path leads to a hidden dell with a spring and a carved mossy bench.

dozed_in_dell.text: Wren dozed in the dell and lost the morning.

mapmakers_bench.text: The bench is carved with initials and maps of mapmakers who rested there, Alder among them.

bench_copied.text: Wren copied every name on the bench and left the island bare.

rope_into_sinkhole.text: A knotted rope tied to a root hangs into the sink-hole; someone had been there before, and recently.

cavern_ways.text: The cavern offers dripping water, a glitter, warm breathing air, and a high hole of daylight.

flood_line.text: A scratched line on the wall marks where the water rises at the turn of the tide.

arch_rising.text: Under the low arch the water is rising; a dry ledge curves toward a paler light.

flood_escape.text: Wren ducked under the arch, was nearly caught by the tide, and scrambled back.

spring_underground.text: Upstream the passage opens into a daylit chamber: the underground face of the island's spring.

ochre_handprints.text: Among quartz veins are ancient handprints in red ochre.

ochre_map.text: The ochre handprints form a map of the island marking the spring and the high peak.

ochre_copied.text: Wren filled a page with the ochre map, which hushed the Chart House keepers.

bat_colony.text: A colony of bats warms the breathing passage.

pup_marked.text: Wren marked the pup's spot to send help later.

pup_attempt_failed.text: Wren could not coax the pup out alone and marked the sea tube for help.

vent_out.text: A root-choked side vent opens high on the slope.

skylight_gallery.text: A slope of fallen rock climbs to the daylight hole; a gallery of formations lies aside.

chimney_failed.text: Wren rushed the chimney, tired, and slid back down.

searcher_lantern.text: In the gallery a goat's bones and a rusted lantern show a searcher came before.

gallery_drawn.text: Wren drew the stone gallery instead of the coast.

black_lake_raft.text: An underground lake with a raft of lashed planks on a pale sand beach.

raft_capsized.text: Wren poled in haste; a lashing broke and Wren swam back.

blind_fish.text: On the far shore blind white fish hang in the shallows; a flowstone stair climbs to daylight.

fish_studied.text: Wren studied the blind fish and left the island blank.

stone_footprints.text: Children's footprints turned to stone mark the hidden lake beach.

prints_mapped.text: Wren mapped every stone footprint and little else.

glowworm_rift.text: A side rift is hung with glowworms; a squeeze leads on and a pool doubles the glow.

squeeze_stuck.text: Wren forced the squeeze, stuck, and wriggled back.

glow_lingered.text: Wren lay under the glowworms and lost the afternoon.

tower_ways.text: The leaning survey tower: a ground room, an outside stair, a cellar hatch, and keeper's quarters.

tower_logbook.text: The ground room holds ruined instruments and a damp logbook recording the tower's last days.

alidade.text: Wren carries a salvaged brass alidade, a sighting rule for fixing distant points.

stair_gap.text: Two thirds up the outside stair a span has fallen; a crumbling ledge goes round.

stair_failed.text: The ledge crumbled and Wren retreated without the view.

summit_beyond_camp.text: The true summit stands higher across the ridge, with a camp of grey canvas below it.

chart_tube.text: The tower cellar holds sound rope, oil, a lamp and a leather chart tube.

alder_draft.text: The tube holds Alder's water-stained half draft with the safe path to the ridge.

draft_copied.text: Wren copied Alder's ruined draft and drew no new ground.

rope_and_oil.text: Wren took rope and oil and followed a chalked surveyor's line toward the ridge.

keeper_quarters.text: The keeper's quarters hold a bunk, a cold hearth, a sea chest and a wall of pinned charts.

alder_wall_charts.text: The pinned charts are a dozen other islands, all Alder's.

wall_charts_studied.text: Wren studied Alder's wall of charts and left this island blank.

alder_family_drawing.text: Alder's sea chest holds a working compass and a child's drawing of a house and three figures.

drawing_kept.text: Wren sat with the child's drawing and the morning went.

beacon_and_dial.text: On the headland: a rusted beacon brazier and a carved stone bearing dial.

beacon_fuel.text: A beacon needs a fuel store somewhere near.

no_fuel_found.text: Wren found no fuel and lost an hour at the cold beacon.

alder_last_note.text: In the fuel store Alder chalked: "Gone to finish the ridge chart, back by the storm."

note_lingered.text: Wren sat with Alder's last note and the chart stayed empty.

stone_dial.text: The dial is Alder's stone compass rose naming every headland, reef and peak.

dial_copied.text: Wren copied every bearing on the dial and drew no coast.

strongbox.text: Under a floor slab is an iron strongbox with a rusted key on a nail.

lock_forced.text: Wren forced the lock, bent the bar and barked a knuckle; the box stayed shut.

alder_pens.text: Wren has Alder's pens (from the camp table, or the brass drawing tools from the tower strongbox).

alder_letter.text: A sealed letter from Alder is addressed "to whoever finishes my work".

letter_read.text: Wren read Alder's letter, a charge to love the island and finish the map.

flats_rule.text: On the flats the returning water comes in faster than a person can run.

flats_ways.text: On the flats: a distant sandbar, firm channel edges, the strand line, and mussel beds.

sandbar_wreck.text: The sandbar holds a boat's ribbed hull; the tide is already turning.

stranded_on_flats.text: Wren waded back chest-deep and spent the day drying out.

valley_stream.text: A green valley mouth leads inland along a stream toward falling water.

cliff_gap.text: The channels gather at a slot of wet sand through the cliffs, bare only at low water.

great_wreck.text: A great old wreck lies keeled over on the bar.

message_bottle.text: A corked bottle with a paper inside lies in the wrack.

bottle_kept.text: Wren kept Alder's bottle note and stopped mapping.

seal_colony.text: A seal colony basks beyond the mussel beds; a deep gully cuts toward the cliffs.

tangled_pup.text: A seal pup on the rock has a flipper snarled in old net.

tangled_pup_marked.text: Wren marked the tangled pup to send help later.

tangled_pup_freed.text: Wren freed the tangled pup but the colony stampeded and the tide window closed.

weed_lines.text: The gully walls carry weed lines far above head height.

gully_flooded.text: Wren lingered in the gully and the tide drove Wren back.

wreck_hold_deck.text: The wreck offers a flooded hold below and a tilted deck to a figurehead above.

caught_in_hold.text: Wren pushed deep in the hold and barely escaped the rising tide.

marigold_story.text: Wren pieced together the Marigold's story and the flats stayed a blur.

flats_from_deck.text: From the stern rail the whole pattern of the flats lies clear.

figurehead_drawn.text: Wren drew the figurehead and the tide cut off the safe way.

dune_marker.text: A surveyor's marker post leans on the highest dune.

dune_failed.text: Wren floundered in the soft dunes and gave up the crest.

flats_from_dune.text: From the marker dune Wren sees and sketches the whole flats.

dune_lingered.text: Wren perfected the flats from the dune and left the rest untouched.

cove_features.text: In the cove: a fresh-water rill, a hand-cut path to the ridge, and a compass rose on a rock pointing up.

cove_rested.text: Wren rested and sketched the cove and lost the morning.

star_slab.text: Halfway up the cove path a tilted slab is pecked with dots.

star_map.text: The dots are a star map by which the first people steered to the island's peak.

star_map_copied.text: Wren copied the star map in full and went no further.

cove_pools_cave.text: The cove's rim holds tide pools and a small breathing sea cave.

alder_cove_tin.text: In the sea cave Alder's initials and a tin with a pencil and the note "The way up is behind you, friend."

tin_lingered.text: Wren sat with Alder's note and climbed out with an empty page.

reef_edge_read.text: The tide pools map the cove's reef edge and safe channel.

reef_pools_mapped.text: Wren mapped every pool and left the island blank.

streams_lingered.text: Wren chased every stream from the spring and the map had no coast.

drainage_mapped.text: Wren mapped the island's whole drainage from the spring.

high_meadow.text: A high meadow with grazing goats lies below the camp trail.

boundary_cairn.text: A tumbled boundary cairn rings the meadow.

alder_boundary_mark.text: The cairn's capstone carries Alder's survey mark fixing the island's middle.

dozed_in_meadow.text: Wren copied the boundary mark, dozed, and woke with half a chart.

alder_half_chart.text: On Alder's camp table lies a half-finished chart: coast true, high ground and far shore blank.

alder_finish_note.text: Across the blank Alder wrote: "Finish this, and it is yours, mapmaker to mapmaker." Tools lie ready on the table.

half_chart_copied.text: Wren copied the half chart; the mate called it a story, not a survey.

alder_trunk_tools.text: Alder's trunk holds spare nibs, ink, a polishing cloth, and a journal cut off by the storm.

journal_name_wish.text: Alder's journal ends with a wish: whoever finds this, finish the chart and give the island its name.

alder_named_cove.text: Alder named the hidden cove in the journal.

journal_kept.text: Wren read the journal all afternoon and rowed out with a blank chart.

summit_cairns.text: Above the camp, cairns mark the safe way between two drops; a scree slope offers a shortcut.

scree_failed.text: The scree slid away; shaken, Wren left the summit for another day.

summit_view.text: From the summit cairn the whole island is visible at once.

summit_gazed.text: Wren only gazed from the summit and reached the beach with a bare chart.

chart_rushed.text: Wren rushed every detail and the chart came out full but wrong.

all_coasts_sighted.text: Wren fixed every coast with careful sightings.

reef_chart.text: Wren fixed the reef and cove channels for safe landings.

far_shore_drawn.text: Wren drew the never-mapped windward shore through the glass.

chart_gathered.text: Wren laid Alder's chart beside the day's sketches; the whole island fits.

chart_inked.text: Wren inked the finished chart in bold lines with Alder's pen.

chart_pencilled.text: Wren pencilled every small detail into the chart.

chart_unfinished_dusk.text: Wren kept adding detail until the ship's horn; the chart was never done.

chart_doubled.text: Wren drew two copies of the finished chart.

chart_named_alder.text: Wren named the island Alder's Island and won the apprenticeship.

chart_named_both.text: Wren named the island for both mapmakers and was made a mapmaker.

chart_signed_survey.text: Wren signed the survey and left the naming to the House; the mate took Wren on.

living_margins.text: Wren ringed the chart with the island's living things and won the honour of naming the next island.

clean_chart_given.text: Wren handed over the clean chart and was taken on.

both_copies_given.text: Wren gave the mate both copies and won the apprenticeship for judgement.

spare_kept.text: Wren gave one copy and kept the spare.

ship_coming.text: The ship answered the mirror signal and turned for the cove.

sailors_landed.text: Two sailors landed in the cove to help.

pup_rescued.text: Wren and the sailors lifted the seal pup out through the sea tube.

turtle_rescued.text: Wren and the sailors carried the turtle to deep water.

camp_tools.text: Alder's camp is long empty; beside the half chart lie pens, a brass spyglass and a small signal mirror.

reef_turtle_sighted.text: Through the spyglass at the summit Wren sees a small turtle on its back in a draining pool on the reef.

pup_heard_in_sea_cave.text: Coming down the cove path, Wren hears a seal pup crying from a sea cave in the cliffs, unable to climb back out.

marigold_settlers.text: The wreck is the Marigold, which carried settler families to the island long ago.

n_open.event: Wren is set ashore alone at first light to chart the island before dusk or lose the apprenticeship.

mg_enter.event: The mangrove maze offers four bearings while the low water lasts.

mg_bridge.event: Halfway across the log bridge, carved driftwood; the tide is rising.

mg_carve.event: The driftwood holds mapmaker's arrows to the sea caves and to high ground.

mg_readmarks.event: Read slowly, the marks name Alder and promise a chart left at a camp on the ridge.

mg_farbank.event: Herons burst up; the path splits between a mud slick and firm palms.

e_mg_mud_trap.event: Wren sticks in the mud and the tide closes over the log bridge.

mg_highground.event: Out of the swamp, Wren sees the reef and the hidden cove; a goat track forks.

mg_oyster.event: Among the oyster rocks a turtle is stranded on its back.

mg_turtle_note.event: Wren could right the turtle or mark it and signal for help from a high place later.

e_mg_turtle_seen.event: Wren rights the turtle; the tide returns and only this corner is mapped.

mg_rockpath.event: A cold sweet seep threads inland: a spring lies above.

mg_seep.event: A seep of clear water climbs into a fern gully that forks to the spring and a mossy overhang.

mg_overhang.event: Under the overhang: an old firepit, a cup, and Alder's name with an arrow to a camp.

e_mg_shelter.event: Wren sketches the shelter all morning and leaves the island blank.

mg_creek.event: Otters slip up the hidden creek; trees and a heron island offer other ways.

mg_otter.event: Upstream sweet water climbs toward a spring and high ground.

mg_trees.event: Without the water, a bright uphill gap or a level game trail.

mg_gametrail.event: The game trail loops with no landmark.

e_mg_lost.event: Wren walks in a circle for an hour; the middle stays blank.

cf_enter.event: The misty ridge offers a switchback, a traverse, a gleaming hollow and a waterfall.

cf_switch.event: The switchback ledge splits to a rock rib and a green shelf.

cf_ledge.event: The rock rib delivers Wren to a grassy bench and a worn path.

cf_shelf.event: The shelf is a surveyor's contour path to the grassy bench.

cf_bench.event: On the windy bench a stony trail climbs toward a speck of grey canvas, a camp; an ancient grove stands aside.

cf_campapproach.event: A line of cairns leads up the broken ground toward where the camp must stand.

camp_ascent1.event: On the open ridge the cairns march toward a far speck, the camp.

camp_ascent2.event: The ridge splits: sheltered ledge or airy crest.

e_ascent_daunted.event: Wren freezes on the ridge and maps from lower down, the camp out of reach.

camp_ascent3a.event: The sheltered ledge, slow and sure, among alpine flowers.

camp_ascent3b.event: The airy crest, exhilarating, down to a level shelf.

camp_ascent4.event: The ways rejoin among clustered cairns below the camp cliff.

camp_ascent5.event: Alder's camp at the end of the cairns, named by a board over its door.

cf_traverse.event: Tracing a stream up, Wren finds the island's spring.

cf_upper.event: Above, a path to the ridge; below, the hollow's pale gleam seen from below that morning.

cf_hollow.event: Behind white orchids sits a moss-furred tin box marked with a compass rose.

cf_box.event: The box holds Alder's field notes and a locket with a girl who looks like Wren.

e_cf_locket.event: Wren pockets the locket and maps in a distracted scrawl.

cf_notes.event: The notes are Alder's: a chart begun and left at a camp on the ridge, and the caverns flood at high tide.

cv_enter.event: Wren climbs down a knotted rope someone left into a cavern of four ways.

cv_water.event: A scratched flood line marks the tide's rise by the underground stream.

cv_arch.event: Water rises under the low arch; a dry ledge leads to light.

e_cv_flood.event: Wren ducks under the arch and is nearly caught by the tide.

cv_upflow.event: Upstream, a daylit chamber is the underground face of the spring.

cv_glitter.event: Quartz veins and ancient red ochre handprints.

cv_ochre.event: The handprints map the island, marking spring and peak, older than the Chart House.

e_cv_paintings.event: Wren fills a page with the ochre map; the Chart House keepers fall silent over it.

cv_deepglow.event: Wren tumbles out onto a hidden cove; a passage murmurs toward water.

cv_warm.event: Bats warm the passage; a seal pup is stranded on a ledge.

cv_pup.event: The pup came in by a flooded sea tube; Wren could mark it and signal the ship for help.

e_cv_pup_fail.event: Wren cannot coax the pup out alone and marks the sea tube.

cv_backout.event: Wren backs out past the bats and finds a vent to the slope.

cv_tohigh.event: Wren emerges on the ridge flank and sees a speck of grey canvas, a camp, above.

tw_enter.event: The leaning survey tower offers ground room, stair, cellar and quarters.

tw_ground.event: Ruined instruments and a swollen logbook of the tower's last days.

e_tw_log.event: The logbook is Alder's: the chart went to the ridge camp before a storm; reading eats the day.

tw_salvage.event: Wren salvages a working alidade, to carry inland toward the ridge or up the stair.

tw_toridge.event: The headland path climbs toward the ridge, where a speck of grey canvas, a camp, shows at last.

tw_stair.event: Two thirds up, a gap in the stair and a crumbling ledge.

tw_top.event: From the top: the ridge, flats, reef and hidden cove; the true summit lies beyond, a canvas camp below it.

tw_ridgeway.event: A knife of rock leads to the bench where the camp trail begins.

tw_cellar.event: The cellar's stores and a leather chart tube that might hold an old survey of the island.

tw_tube.event: The tube holds an abandoned draft signed Alder; the good copy went to the ridge camp.

e_tw_draft.event: Wren copies Alder's draft and draws no new ground.

tw_supplies.event: Wren takes rope and oil and follows a chalk line toward the ridge and a speck of grey canvas, a camp.

tf_enter.event: The flats glitter; the Chart House rule is that the sea returns faster than a person runs.

tf_sandbar.event: A wrecked hull on the sandbar as the tide turns.

e_tf_stranded.event: Wren is cut off and wades back chest-deep.

tf_sketchrun.event: Wren sketches fast and runs, reaching firm ground; a green gap leads inland.

tf_gap.event: A valley stream leads up toward falling water.

tf_channel.event: The firm channel edges lead to a cliff gap, a rise, or the great wreck.

tf_cliffgap.event: Through the low-water gap lies a hidden cove, hidden from every passing ship.

tf_strand.event: Shells, rope, a net float, and a message bottle.

tf_bottle.event: The note, in a small careful hand, is Alder's: the chart waits at the ridge camp for whoever finishes the work.

e_tf_bottle.event: Wren keeps the note and waits for the ship.

L_cove.event: The calm hidden cove, no chart has shown it: a rill, a hand-cut path, a compass rose pointing up.

e_cove_rest.event: Wren rests in the calm and the morning goes.

cove_rise.event: Up a hand-cut path, a slab pecked with dots.

cove_starrock.event: The dots are a star map of the first people, steering to the peak.

e_star_map.event: Wren copies the star map; the Chart House keepers lean close.

cove_ridge.event: On the bench, a stony trail climbs toward a speck of grey canvas, a camp.

L_fresh.event: At the spring, where any chart must begin, Wren sees water run five ways; a path climbs toward a speck of grey canvas, a camp, on the ridge.

e_fresh_linger.event: Wren chases every stream and the map has no coast.

fresh_study.event: Wren maps the island's whole drainage.

fresh_climb.event: The path climbs to a high meadow of goats; the camp trail lies beyond.

fresh_meadow.event: A tumbled boundary cairn rings the meadow.

fresh_cairn.event: The capstone carries a survey mark, an arrow and the name Alder for the island's middle.

e_fresh_cairn.event: Wren copies the mark, dozes, and wakes with half a chart.

L_camp.event: Inside Alder's long-empty camp: a cot, a cold stove, a half-finished chart with pens, a spyglass and a signal mirror beside it, a tin trunk.

camp_chart.event: Across the chart's blank, Alder's note: finish this and it is yours; tools lie ready.

e_camp_copy.event: Wren copies the half chart; the mate calls it a story, not a survey.

camp_trunk.event: The trunk holds spare nibs, ink, a polishing cloth, and a journal cut off by the storm.

camp_journal.event: The journal tells Alder's island life (the far shore only dreamed of) and asks the finder to finish and name the island.

e_camp_journal.event: Wren reads the journal all afternoon and rows out with a blank chart.

camp_ready.event: Tools in hand and the half chart under one arm, the pens and the glass, Wren sets out for the summit.

camp_summitpath.event: Carrying Alder's chart and tools, Wren faces cairns between two drops, or a scree shortcut.

e_camp_scree.event: The scree slides; Wren leaves the summit for another day.

ridge_notch.event: Through a wind notch to the boulder field.

wind_gap.event: Block by block across the boulders to the top.

L_summit.event: From the summit cairn the whole island lies below; signal the ship with Alder's mirror, survey, or gaze.

e_summit_gaze.event: Wren only gazes and reaches the beach at dusk with a bare chart.

summit_survey.event: Wren lays Alder's half chart on a stone and works fast; what to fix first.

e_ch_rush.event: Wren rushes every detail; the chart is full but wrong.

ch_sightings.event: Alder's brass spyglass fixes every coast.

ch_reef.event: Wren fixes the reef and cove channels Alder began.

e_ch_reef.event: The safe-landing chart wins the apprenticeship.

ch_gather.event: Alder's chart and the day's sketches fit as one island.

ch_table.event: How to draw the final chart: ink, pencil (every tide pool, stream and cave), or two copies.

ch_ink.event: Wren inks the chart bold with Alder's good pen; the cove and reef lettered.

ch_pencil.event: Wren pencils every detail: tide pools, streams, cave mouths, headlands and reef.

e_ch_dusk.event: Wren keeps adding detail until the ship's horn; the chart is never done.

ch_double.event: Wren draws two copies, one for the Chart House and one to keep.

ch_sign.event: Alder left the banner of the half chart blank for whoever finished it: how to fill it.

e_ch_alder_name.event: Wren names it Alder's Island; the Chart House has its new apprentice.

e_ch_both_name.event: Wren names it for both mapmakers and is made a mapmaker.

e_ch_survey.event: Wren signs the survey small in the corner, as careful surveyors do; the mate takes Wren on.

ch_sign_double.event: How to present the two charts.

e_ch_double_win.event: Wren gives both copies; the mate prizes the judgement.

e_ch_spare.event: Wren gives one and keeps the spare.

summit_signal.event: Remembering Alder's mirror, Wren could flash the ship, back early off the reef, to help the turtle seen stranded on the reef through the spyglass.

signal_aim.event: Wren catches the low sun on the mirror and aims at the sail.

signal_flash.event: Flash, pause, flash, in the Chart House distress rhythm.

ship_turns.event: The ship comes about toward the cove, called by a lost mapmaker's mirror.

race_down.event: Wren runs down past the camp and a hand-cut path toward the cove as the ship's boat rows in.

meet_boat.event: Two sailors land; the turtle on the reef and a seal pup Wren heard crying in a sea cave on the way down need help.

e_rescue_pup.event: Following the crying into the sea cave, three pairs of hands lift the pup out and down to the tide; Wren is taken on.

e_rescue_turtle.event: Wren leads the sailors along the rocks to the reef and frees the turtle; Wren is taken on.

mg_lagoon.event: The lagoon holds a dugout, a root tunnel, and a driftwood dam.

mg_canoe.event: The dugout might float if tested carefully.

e_mg_canoe.event: Wren trusts the dugout too far and it sinks.

mg_paddle.event: From the water the shore traces clearly; cleared ground lies across the lagoon.

mg_lagfar.event: The cleared ground holds a stone mound and posts; a path climbs to the creek.

mg_ruin.event: The stones are a vanished fishing camp, older than any chart and the Chart House.

e_mg_village.event: Wren maps the village in detail and little else.

mg_lagtunnel.event: The root tunnel forks toward sky and deeper dark.

e_mg_tunnellost.event: Wren gets lost in branching roots and backtracks.

mg_dam.event: A survey stake burned with a number and the name Alder stands in the otters' dam.

e_mg_stake.event: Wren takes the stake as a keepsake and barely maps.

cf_falls.event: A waterfall offers wet rocks, a mossy log above the lip, and pale shapes in the pool.

cf_fallclimb.event: The wet rocks have good holds for a careful climber.

e_cf_slip.event: Wren scrambles too fast and slides into the pool.

cf_fallcross.event: The mossy log holds; Wren crosses to the upper traverse.

cf_fallpool.event: The pale shapes are a notched slab: a water gauge with the name Alder cut in one corner.

e_cf_gauge.event: Wren copies Alder's gauge and the coast stays blank.

cv_skylight.event: A rock slope climbs to the daylight hole; a gallery of formations lies aside.

cv_chimney.event: A narrow chimney leads to the surface.

e_cv_chimney.event: Wren rushes the chimney and slides back down.

cv_gallery.event: Among the formations, goat bones and a searcher's rusted lantern.

e_cv_lantern.event: Wren draws the gallery instead of the coast.

tw_quarters.event: The keeper's quarters: bunk, sea chest, wall of charts, where the mapmaker lived.

tw_wallcharts.event: The wall holds a dozen other islands, all signed Alder, a life's work.

e_tw_charts.event: Wren studies Alder's charts and leaves this island blank.

tw_seachest.event: The chest holds a working compass and a child's drawing, For Alder, of a family left ashore.

e_tw_drawing.event: Wren sits with the drawing and the morning goes.

tf_mussel.event: Mussel beds, a seal colony, and a deep gully.

tf_seals.event: A seal pup is tangled in net; marking it may be wiser than spooking the colony.

e_tf_seals.event: Wren frees the pup; the colony stampedes and the tide window closes.

tf_gully.event: Weed lines high on the gully walls mark how fast it floods.

e_tf_gully.event: Wren dawdles and the tide drives Wren out.

ch_farshore.event: Through the brass glass Wren draws the never-mapped windward shore.

e_ch_farshore.event: The unknown coast alone wins the apprenticeship.

ch_seal_final.event: Ring the margins with the island's living things, or hand over clean.

e_ch_living.event: The living chart wins the apprenticeship and the honour of naming the next island.

e_ch_clean.event: The clean chart, handed over as drawn, wins the apprenticeship.

mg_heron.event: Wren poles to the heron island: blind, mud bank, rookery.

mg_blind.event: The blind, its doorpost cut with the name Alder, is carved with a tide table and bearings; a plank walk leads to the seep.

e_mg_tidetable.event: Wren copies the tide table and leaves the island's shape.

mg_mudbank.event: A firm sand ribbon crosses the mud bank.

e_mg_birdstorm.event: Wren cuts across, startles the flock, and sinks.

mg_farchannel.event: Across the far channel a lookout rise waits.

mg_rookery.event: Wren returns a fallen chick and sketches the rookery.

e_mg_chick.event: Wren watches the rookery too long.

cf_grove.event: In the grove: a frayed rope ladder and a small shell-dressed cairn shrine.

cf_canopy.event: The lower rungs hold; the upper ones look rotten.

e_cf_ladder.event: A rotten rung breaks and Wren climbs down without the view.

cf_treetop.event: At the top is a surveyor's lookout, its brass sighting ring stamped Alder; Wren takes sightings.

e_cf_canopy.event: Wren lingers in the canopy and draws one view.

cf_shrine.event: The shrine, older than any chart, was set by the island's first people.

e_cf_shrine.event: Wren sits long by the shrine and draws only that.

cv_lake.event: An underground lake with a raft on a pale beach.

cv_raft.event: The raft will cross if poled slowly.

e_cv_raft.event: Wren poles in haste; the raft tips.

cv_farcave.event: Blind white fish and a flowstone stair to daylight.

e_cv_fish.event: Wren studies the fish and leaves the island blank.

cv_lakebeach.event: Children's footprints turned to stone on the hidden beach.

tw_beacon.event: The headland holds a rusted brazier and a carved bearing dial.

tw_brazier.event: A beacon needs fuel; search or give up.

e_tw_nofuel.event: No fuel found; an hour lost.

tw_fuelstore.event: In the fuel store, under the keeper's tally, a last note signed Alder: back by the storm.

e_tw_note.event: Wren sits with Alder's last note and the return that never came; the chart stays empty.

tw_viewdial.event: The dial is a stone compass rose of the whole coast, signed at its foot Alder.

e_tw_dial.event: Wren copies every bearing and draws no coast.

tf_wreck.event: The great wreck: flooded hold below, tilted deck above.

tf_hold.event: The tide turns silver on the flats; one quick look or push deeper.

e_tf_hold.event: Wren pushes too deep and barely escapes the hold.

tf_cargo.event: The green bell names the Marigold, which carried settler families to the island long ago.

e_tf_bell.event: Wren pieces together the story of the Marigold and its settler families.

tf_deck.event: From the high bow rail the whole flats lie clear.

e_tf_figurehead.event: Wren draws the figurehead and the tide cuts off the way.

cove_pools.event: The cove rim holds tide pools and a breathing sea cave.

cove_seacave.event: In the sea cave a name and date cut in the rock, Alder, and a tin with a pencil and a kind note.

e_cove_tin.event: Wren sits with Alder's note and climbs out with an empty page.

cove_rockpool.event: The pools map the reef edge and safe channel, valuable work for any chart.

e_cove_reefmap.event: Wren maps every pool and leaves the island blank.

cv_rift.event: A glowworm rift with a squeeze and a doubling pool.

cv_squeeze.event: The squeeze is narrow; slow is the way.

e_cv_squeeze.event: Wren forces the squeeze, sticks, and backs out.

cv_glowworm.event: Wren draws the rift by its own light; an easy way leads to the spring.

e_cv_glow.event: Wren lies under the glowworms and loses the afternoon.

cf_dell.event: A hidden dell with a spring, a carved bench, and a way to the upper ridge.

e_cf_dell_lost.event: Wren dozes in the dell and loses the morning.

cf_dellspring.event: The dell stream leads down to the island's true spring.

cf_dellcarve.event: The bench is carved with mapmakers' marks, among them the name Alder.

e_cf_carve.event: Wren copies every name on the bench and leaves the island bare.

tw_slab.event: Under a slab, an iron strongbox and a rusted key.

e_tw_slab.event: Wren forces the lock and fails.

tw_cache.event: The key turns: brass drawing tools and a sealed letter to whoever finishes my work, signed Alder.

e_tw_cache.event: Wren reads Alder's letter and the light goes.

tf_dune.event: A marker post on the highest dune; soft sand.

e_tf_dune.event: Wren flounders and gives up the crest.

tf_marker.event: From the marker dune the whole flats lie clear.

e_tf_marker.event: Wren perfects the flats and leaves the rest.

continuity_notes: UNESTABLISHED NAME (the dominant defect): Alder is introduced explicitly only at mg_readmarks, mg_overhang, cf_notes, e_tw_log, tw_tube and tf_bottle, yet named as already known on routes that never reach those: mg_dam, e_mg_stake, mg_blind, e_mg_tidetable, mg_ruin (mangrove lagoon/heron routes); cf_fallpool ('Alder's hand again'), e_cf_gauge, cf_treetop, cf_shrine, cf_dellcarve (cloud-forest routes not via cf_notes); cv_ochre ('older than Alder'); tw_wallcharts, tw_seachest, tw_fuelstore ('a hand Wren was learning to know'), tw_viewdial, tw_cache ('a hand Wren now knew well') on tower routes; cove_seacave ('knew the hand. Alder's') and cove_rockpool; fresh_cairn; and camp_ascent5 / L_camp ('Alder's camp') for any route that met no Alder clue (for example c_n_start_2 > c_cf_enter_1 > c_cf_switch_1 > cf_ledge > cf_bench > camp).

UNESTABLISHED REFERENCE: camp_ascent5 says 'The driftwood arrows, the scratched names, the line of patient cairns, all of them had led here'; the driftwood is only on mg_carve and the scratched name only on mg_overhang, so almost every route into the camp asserts clues the reader never met.

MERGE DEFECT, 'every clue pointed to the camp': cf_bench ('the high camp Wren kept hearing about, the place every clue pointed to'), cove_ridge and tw_toridge ('all the day's clues kept pointing toward') presuppose chart_at_camp, missing on routes via cf_switch, via L_cove from tw_top/tf_cliffgap/cv_deepglow, and via tw_salvage.

MERGE DEFECT, tools: ch_sightings uses 'the salvaged brass rule' (the alidade, found only at tw_salvage); ch_farshore uses 'the brass glass' and camp_ready claims 'the pens, the glass' (spyglass and pens are in the trunk, opened only on camp_trunk; camp_chart shows unspecified tools on the table); L_summit and summit_signal use 'Alder's mirror' (trunk only), so routes c_L_camp_1 > camp_chart and c_L_camp_3 reach a mirror they never found; ch_ink uses 'Alder's good pen' likewise.
MERGE DEFECT: ch_sign says 'Whoever finishes the chart, Alder's journal had said, should name the island', but the journal is read only on c_camp_trunk_2 > camp_journal.

MERGE DEFECT: L_fresh says 'Whoever had drawn the first ochre map had marked this very place', but the ochre map is seen only on cv_ochre; every other route into the spring (mg_seep, cf_traverse, tf_gap, L_cove, cf_dellspring) never met it.

IMPOSSIBLE ON EVERY ROUTE: ch_pencil pencils in 'the handprint cave and the star slab and the vanished village' (and the orchids). The handprint cave (cv_glitter), star slab (cove_rise) and village (mg_ruin) are on mutually exclusive first-act branches, so no route has seen all of them.

MERGE DEFECT, rescue finale: summit_signal and meet_boat say Wren 'spotted from the heights' the seal pup in the warm cave and the turtle on the reef, and offer to lead the sailors to each. The pup is met only on c_cv_enter_3 > cv_warm and the turtle only on c_mg_enter_2 > mg_oyster, and both branches are mutually exclusive, so no route has met both; most routes have met neither. A pup inside a cave cannot be seen from the summit at all.

PLAIN CONTRADICTION, same route (c_mg_enter_2 > c_mg_oyster_1 > c_mg_turtle_note_1 ... > summit_signal > meet_boat > c_meet_boat_2): mg_oyster puts the turtle among the oyster rocks on the mangrove coast (left of the landing beach); e_rescue_turtle has Wren lead the sailors 'out across the flats to the reef' (the flats are to the right).

PLAIN CONTRADICTION, ink versus pencil (c_ch_table_2 > ch_pencil > c_ch_pencil_1 > ch_sign > c_ch_sign_3 > ch_seal_final > c_ch_seal_final_2): e_ch_clean hands over 'the clean inked masterwork exactly as drawn ... fixed forever in black ink', but on this route the chart was pencilled soft and grey with every small detail.

PLAIN CONTRADICTION, same route possible (c_tf_cargo_1 > tf_cliffgap > L_cove > cove_rise > cove_starrock): tf_cargo calls the Marigold the ship of 'the island's first settlers'; cove_starrock, cv_ochre, cv_lakebeach, mg_ruin and cf_shrine attribute the island's first finding and mapping to an ancient people long before any chart.
UNESTABLISHED REFERENCE, cv routes: cv_deepglow calls it 'the hidden cove, seen from below now', implying an earlier view from above that no cave route has had.
SOFT: tw_cellar's 'the very map the whole island seemed to whisper about' and tf_bottle's 'the hand was one Wren was coming to know' presuppose clues not met on those routes.

SOFT: L_cove and tf_cliffgap call the cove 'a place no chart had ever shown' and ch_ink has 'the cove and the reef named at last', while camp_chart shows the cove fixed on Alder's chart and camp_journal says Alder named the hidden cove.
SOFT: cv_enter says someone had been in the sink-hole 'and recently', but the only predecessor in the book is Alder, long gone.

SOFT, time and the ship: n_open has the ship leave and return at dusk; summit_signal finds it 'standing off the reef, patient, waiting for dusk' all day. Several endings mix 'morning', 'sun climbed', 'past noon' and 'dusk' loosely (for example e_mg_turtle_seen's 'slipping light' in the morning).

MINOR: mg_seep's 'the seep of clear water' is unintroduced on the root-tunnel route (c_mg_lagoon_2 > c_mg_lagtunnel_1); cv_tohigh, tw_salvage, tw_top and L_fresh mention 'the ridge camp' / 'the camp' as known on routes where it is first heard there.

UNPAID SETUP: cf_box's locket holds a girl who 'looked a little like Wren's own' eyes; no route returns to it. Wren's marked turtle or pup (turtle_marked, pup_marked, tangled_pup_marked) are only paid off at meet_boat, and the net-tangled pup on the flats (tf_seals) is never mentioned again.
PROSE BUG (not continuity): e_cove_tin ends 'and could not bring itself to mind', a pronoun slip for Wren, who otherwise never takes a pronoun.
